name: Caber Tosser Fergus

intro.text: The caber is about nineteen feet of larch and weighs as much as a small wardrobe. You don't throw it for distance. You throw it to turn over, like a clock hand at twelve. Want to see?

win: Fair play. You'd have tipped it clean.
after: A caber is judged on the turn, not the distance. Twelve o'clock is a perfect score. I'm told it takes years to stop hitting my own foot.
